newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: POSCO doubles stainless steel output.
newsitem.headline: POSCO doubles stainless steel output.

text.p: South Korea's Pohang Iron and Steel Co Ltd (POSCO) said on Friday it has doubled its stainless steel production to 840,000 tonnes a year from the current 420,000 tonnes by expanding its facilities.
POSCO has spent a total of 523 billion won for the expansion to become the world's biggest stainless steel producer in a single plant, a company spokesman said.
The expansion will enable POSCO to produce 49 different types of stainless steel, including high glossness plates, auto-body frames and 0.1 mm thin plates. Before it only made 24 types.
The spokesman said South Korea's annual demand for stainless hot-rolled products was expected to rise to one million tonnes in 2000.
